verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents user-side deadlines: a 48-hour payment window, a 24-hour name reservation, 5 days for corrections and 30 days for beneficial-owner data. It also lists urgent-tier fees. None of this states how long the registry currently takes to process a given incorporation type. Publishing processing times is a fair axis for an online government registration service, so the absence of such data is "none", not "na".
